alternatives.label: International management and organisational strategy
alternatives.concept: A broad management curriculum connects international strategy and governance with accounting, finance, economics, law, marketing, organisational behaviour, leadership and quantitative and qualitative research. Its social-science methods complement Radboud’s integrated organisational curriculum; UCR does not reproduce the compulsory Global Value Chains or IBA thesis sequence. These are related UCR studies, not completion of the IBA degree or its optional minor certificate. The renewed IBA thesis-entry conditions still need clarification.
alternatives.labelReason: The title names the dominant course sequence: cross-border business and organisational strategy with economics, management and research methods.
progression: Every actual UCR workbook prerequisite and assigned-term offering passes. Courses with no formal prerequisite may occur early, including Market Research, sustainability governance and qualitative methods. PPD is in Year1. This verifies the UCR schedule only; renewed Radboud thesis-entry equivalence remains unresolved.
traceOverrides: uses consumer research, team product development and cost analysis to practice entrepreneurship in an organisational setting
teaches business strategy and strategic change in digital markets
examines how AI adoption changes firms, workers, innovation and governance through business cases

alternatives.label: Responsible enterprise and sustainable change
alternatives.concept: A responsible-enterprise curriculum joins entrepreneurship and organisational leadership to climate, circular-economy assessment and sustainability governance. It studies the environmental constraints and social value of business decisions through both management and environmental-science courses; specialist IBA value-chain and thesis requirements remain distinct. These are related UCR studies, not completion of the IBA degree or its optional minor certificate. The renewed IBA thesis-entry conditions still need clarification.
alternatives.labelReason: The title names the dominant course sequence: sustainable enterprise with climate, circular-economy and governance courses.
progression: Every actual UCR workbook prerequisite and assigned-term offering passes. Courses with no formal prerequisite may occur early, including Market Research, sustainability governance and qualitative methods. PPD is in Year1. This verifies the UCR schedule only; renewed Radboud thesis-entry equivalence remains unresolved.
alternatives.distinctness: Six course replacements (45 EC) shift the first programme toward environmental science, life-cycle assessment, sustainability governance and public economics; these implement the named responsible-enterprise evidence and change the academic work, not merely the title.
traceOverrides: uses consumer research, team product development and cost analysis to practice entrepreneurship in an organisational setting
teaches business strategy and strategic change in digital markets
examines how AI adoption changes firms, workers, innovation and governance through business cases

alternatives.label: Business analytics and digital innovation
alternatives.concept: A digital-business curriculum combines strategy, finance, markets and organisations with programming, databases, mathematical methods, data science, machine learning and AI ethics. The computational sequence provides practical data skills behind digital innovation while leaving Radboud’s independent IBA thesis and detailed organisational requirements distinct. These are related UCR studies, not completion of the IBA degree or its optional minor certificate. The renewed IBA thesis-entry conditions still need clarification.
alternatives.labelReason: The title names the dominant course sequence: business decisions with a substantial programming, data and AI sequence.
progression: Every actual UCR workbook prerequisite and assigned-term offering passes. Courses with no formal prerequisite may occur early, including Market Research, sustainability governance and qualitative methods. PPD is in Year1. This verifies the UCR schedule only; renewed Radboud thesis-entry equivalence remains unresolved.
alternatives.distinctness: The programming, database, data-science, machine-learning, deep-learning, mathematics and AI-ethics sequence changes the actual methods of study. It differs by nine courses (67.5 EC) from management and by eleven (82.5 EC) from sustainable enterprise, and both differences implement the evidenced digital expertise direction.

notes.text: The UCR alternatives can share international strategy, marketing, economics, organisational behaviour and business research with Radboud while concentrating differently on sustainable enterprise or technical analytics. Radboud’s prescribed Global Value Chains, Systems Theory and independent IBA thesis remain separate requirements; the 30-EC third-year flexibility window is genuine choice space.

audience.programmeDescription: International Business Administration studies how organisations operate across borders and respond to economic, social and environmental change. It combines management, marketing, finance and organisational research with responsible enterprise.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The UCR programmes offer three different emphases: broad international management, responsible enterprise with environmental science, or business decisions with technical data analysis. They include substantial business study and related research skills. They do not reproduce every IBA requirement, including detailed global value chains, systems theory and the independent IBA thesis. Radboud’s thesis-entry rule still names older methods courses; its application to the renewed curriculum needs clarification.

curriculum.limitation: The credit framework totals 180 EC: 150 EC required and 30 EC open study. Each optional minor uses 18 EC within that space. Internships and exchange are optional. Thesis entry requires at least 90 programme EC and named academic-skills and methods requirements; how the older methods names apply to the renewed curriculum remains unresolved. This comparison does not certify that progression rule.

componentNotes.y3-thesis: Required 12-EC individual thesis. The adopted rules specify at least 90 EC and Academic Skills, Statistics and Methods of Research and Intervention. The renewed-curriculum methods equivalence needs clarification.
